title: Physics #17 · every force on a crate on a slope (F40 copy of @sciencevisualised 1.45M; studio, lofi, loop)

captions.instagram:
Every force on a crate on a slope, in 10 seconds 📦
F pulls it up · friction drags it down · N holds it off the slope · weight pulls straight down

Class 11 Physics · Laws of motion (the inclined plane)
Physics, visualised #17

Weight splits in two:
mg sin θ: down the slope
mg cos θ: into the slope

The four equations:
F − f − mg sin θ = ma (along the slope)
N − mg cos θ = 0 (nothing moves off the slope)
N = mg cos θ
f = μN
